name: lifi_bridge_executor
description: Seller-executed swap/bridge via LI.FI. Buyer transfers FROM token on Base to the executor wallet first (requiredFunds=true), then executor broadcasts the LI.FI transaction to bridge/swap to the receiver on destination chain. Example: bridge 5 USDC from base to arbitrum receiver 0x... (optional: toToken ETH, slippage 0.5, dryRun true, allowBridges ["across"], allowExchanges ["uniswap"]).

command.description: Natural command string. Example: bridge 5 USDC from base to arbitrum receiver 0xabc...

token.description: Source token symbol or address on Base, e.g. USDC or 0x...

toToken.description: Destination token symbol or address on destination chain. If omitted, defaults to token.

fromChain.description: Source chain. MVP executor supports Base only. Accepts: base.

slippage.description: Slippage in percent, e.g. 0.5 means 0.5%. Default: 0.5.

dryRun.description: If true, returns quote + txRequest but does NOT broadcast.

order.description: Route preference (depends on LI.FI). Example: CHEAPEST or FASTEST.
